premises.text: Car owners waste time going to shops, arranging rides, and risk being ripped off on repairs
premises.evidence_span: don't waste your time going to a shop, begging friends for a ride, and then hoping and maybe praying that you don't get ripped off

premises.text: Customers book transparent, comparable-priced mobile mechanics online in under a minute for home or office service seven days a week
premises.evidence_span: you can take care of your car problems in less than 60 seconds

premises.text: Symptom search and on-spot inspection with a mechanic app yield estimates using fixed platform prices
premises.evidence_span: Simply go online and say, smoke from the car. We'll immediately tell you what are the possible reasons

premises.text: Integration with major parts suppliers plus large labor/parts datasets enables fixed fair prices without shady markups
premises.evidence_span: We are fully integrated with the three largest car parts suppliers in North America

premises.text: Independent mechanics with their own tools can do most repairs and earn more than shop wages while customers save
premises.evidence_span: all of us mechanics own our own scanners and tools to perform about 80% of all car repairs

premises.text: Target market is out-of-warranty older cars with large annual repair spend

value.text: Fair, convenient car repair at the customer's location with transparent fixed prices
value.evidence_span: Your Mechanic is the car mechanic that comes to you

secondary_value.text: Mechanics earn more than shop wages while customers save
secondary_value.evidence_span: you save money, I make more, and everyone wins

causal_links.evidence_span: don't waste your time going to a shop
this awesome mechanic, Mike, will fix your car at your home, your office, or wherever you are
this allows us to give you a fixed, fair price every time
When you hire me through your mechanic, you save money, I make more
Making this a $160 billion market opportunity
